description: Add a light to the scene. 'no' selects the light type and must come from studio_search_catalog with catalog='light' (directional, point, spot...). Position, orientation and light settings are optional. Note: 'range' and 'spot_angle' only affect point/spot lights; a directional light is aimed with 'rot' alone. Returns the created object with its resulting light state.

rot.description: euler degrees — this is what aims a directional or spot light

output.description: same shape as one entry of studio_list_objects, with the 'light' field filled
